2607.05915.title: PCBWorld: A Benchmark Environment for Engine-Grounded PCB Design Automation
2607.05915.paper_summary: PCB routing is the task of connecting the nets of a board with copper traces under strict design rules, yet learning-based methods still lag behind rule-based routers. We introduce PCBWorld, an open-source engine-grounded PCB routing environment built on the KiCad EDA engine. As a human engineer does, agents in PCBWorld interactively route a board through the engine's native operations, using its Design Rule Check (DRC) feedback to keep the routing within the design rules. The environment supports both RL policies and tool-using LLM agents. Alongside the environment, PCBWorld-Bench provides three dataset families in KiCad's native board format (.kicad_pcb), covering two types of controllable synthetic instances and 679 real open-source boards. It scores any completed board with eight engine-checked evaluation metrics, regardless of the routing method. In our experiments, agents in PCBWorld consistently outperformed grid-action RL policies and open-loop LLM baselines, and an RL policy trained only on synthetic boards transferred zero-shot to real boards, approaching rule-based routers. These results position the engine-grounded, interactive approach of PCBWorld as a promising foundation for advancing the routing ability of both RL and LLM agents.
2607.05915.paper_summary_zh: PCB 路由是將電路板的網路用銅箔連接起來的任務，並遵循嚴格的設計規則，但基於學習的方法仍然落後於基於規則的路由器。我們介紹了 PCBWorld，一個基於 KiCad EDA 引擎的開源引擎驅動 PCB 路由環境。像人類工程師一樣，PCBWorld 中的代理通過引擎的本地操作互動式地路由電路板，利用其設計規則檢查 (DRC) 反饋來保持路由在設計規則之內。該環境支持 RL 策略和使用工具的 LLM 代理。除了環境外，PCBWorld-Bench 提供了三個數據集系列，格式為 KiCad 的本地電路板格式 (.kicad_pcb)，涵蓋兩種類型的可控合成實例和 679 個真實的開源電路板。它對任何完成的電路板進行八個引擎檢查的評估指標打分，無論路由方法如何。在我們的實驗中，PCBWorld 中的代理始終超越了網格行動 RL 策略和開放式 LLM 基準，並且僅在合成電路板上訓練的 RL 策略在真實電路板上實現了零樣本轉移，接近基於規則的路由器。這些結果使 PCBWorld 的引擎驅動互動方法成為推進 RL 和 LLM 代理路由能力的有希望的基礎。
